Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Go forth, Dungeon Runner, to Mutanous Malaise! Then, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: An Explorer's Task

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go forth, Dungeon Runner, to Mutanous Malaise! Then, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

You seem like a hip and with-it Dungeon Runner, so this next dungeon is going to be right up your alley. The Mutanous Malaise is actually a recording studio for up and coming creature bands. Ever since creature bands like N'Stync, New Mobs on the Block, and the Whackstreet Boyz became popular, the King's Board of Trustees wanted in on the action.

Mutanous Malaise is being run by Rotgut, an industry vet. He is most famous for being the drummer/singer in the first speed metal creature band, Mutanous Melee. The band was huge, but large egos, birthday partying too hard, and TKing broke them up. Since then Rotgut has gone on to produce hit after hit for other creature bands, so getting him to be the Boss of Mutanous Malaise was quite a coup. Rotgut is not perfect though. Rumors have persisted that he has been involved in dealing arms, even Weapons of Mass Destruction, but we don't have any proof about this...yet.

I want you to get familiar with the dungeon, so enter into the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine and then make your way into the first level of Upper Mutanous Malaise. When you have explored those two areas return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Well, what did you think? Did you get a chance to listen to any of the 'music' they are working on? That sure is some catchy crap!

Objectives:

  • Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine
  • Mutanous Malaise - Level 1

Client level range: 30–50
